transform.sql: SELECT DATETIME, MAX(READ_RESPONSE_RATE) as MAX_READ_RESPONSE_RATE, MAX(WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE) as MAX_WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE, CAST(AVG( CASE READ_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN null ELSE READ_RESPONSE_RATE END) AS REAL) as ZERO_IGNORED_AVG_READ_RESPONSE_RATE, CAST(AVG( CASE WRITE_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN null ELSE WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE END ) AS REAL) as ZERO_IGNORED_AVG_WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE FROM PI_LDS GROUP BY DATETIME;
